session_definitions.session: one S-EMBER video; questions ordered by question_time; policy fixed for the whole session
session_definitions.session_type: the session's most frequent question category

variants.unknown_as_unavailable: PRIMARY: UNKNOWN latency = unavailable (utility 0), as Part 1
variants.known_questions_only: questions where every policy's latency is known
variants.recent_vs_full_known: recent vs full (K1 / H2) only, on questions where both are known

session_definitions.information: a fixed policy uses only frames up to each question time; best-policy choice per session is an ex-post oracle (descriptive)

assumptions: history arms held at the cloud upload only frames newer than the previous question of the same video
sessions: continuous-upload policies have only the newest frame pending at question time
device configurations use H1 / H2 answers (H100 vLLM, identical requests) with Orin latency
frame bytes: PNG medians measured on 200 S-EMBER frames per resolution; raw = W*H*3
